description: This file defines the interface for tasklet management in the lighttpd server, including creation, configuration, and execution of tasklets within a thread pool.

methods.name: li_tasklet_pool_new
methods.description: Creates a new tasklet pool associated with an event loop and configured with a specified number of threads.

methods.name: li_tasklet_pool_free
methods.description: Blocks until all tasks are completed and frees the tasklet pool.

methods.name: li_tasklet_pool_set_threads
methods.description: Adjusts the number of threads used by the tasklet pool, potentially stopping old threads and waiting for tasks to finish.

methods.name: li_tasklet_pool_get_threads
methods.description: Returns the current number of threads used by the tasklet pool.

methods.name: li_tasklet_push
methods.description: Enqueues a tasklet to the pool for execution, specifying run and finished callbacks.
